# tai-shis

> Personal site of Tai Shishiba, a computer science student at Mount Royal University. 
> The whole site is available as plain markdown over curl.

To read it, curl the site:

```
curl https://tai-shis.com
```

Any path that isn't listed below returns the whole site.

## Sections

- [home](https://tai-shis.com/home): me, socials, about, propaganda
- [projects](https://tai-shis.com/projects): things I've built
- [resume](https://tai-shis.com/resume): education, experience, projects, technical skills
- [hobbies](https://tai-shis.com/hobbies): hobby progress stats

Example: `curl https://tai-shis.com/resume`
